messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a staggered publish for py-sdk@1.12.0 and ts-sdk@2.5.0 during the Tuesday change window (2024-08-13 02:00-03:30 UTC). Will push py canary first, then TS canary 15m later. Need pins and a quick deprecation blurb for the legacy sync client.
ben: +1. Any rollback criteria?
mar ia: Rollback if >2 user-facing errors / auth failures in canary at 95%ile, or if publish bot reports signature mismatch. Otherwise we proceed and watch telemetry for 30m.
sam: noted. I'll pin the internal integrations to py@1.12.0-canary and ts@2.5.0-canary during window.
leo: @maria can you paste the exact release notes we'll ship to the docs page? I can copy to release notes PR.
maria: Sure — short note below, keep it minimal for changelog.
```
py-sdk 1.12.0 (canary)
- Add streaming helper & improved retry logic for transient 5xx.
- Deprecate legacy sync client; see migration guide.
- Security: refresh default cipher list.

ts-sdk 2.5.0 (canary)
- Add function-calling helpers & streaming-friendly typings.
- Performance: smarter batching suggestions.
```
frank: Deploy-bot FYI: starting canary publish for py-sdk now.
deploy-bot: publish job started: py-sdk@1.12.0-canary, job_id=job_48291
deploy-bot: publish job completed: py-sdk@1.12.0-canary, status=success, artifacts signed.
frank: All good on py canary smoke. No auth regressions in first 10m.
sam: Rolling TS canary in 5m. Pinning internal TS integrators to canary now.
deploy-bot: publish job started: ts-sdk@2.5.0-canary, job_id=job_48292
deploy-bot: ERROR: signature verification failed for ts-sdk@2.5.0-canary, checksum mismatch.
leo: Ugh — that's the signer glitch we saw last sprint. Could be npm publish pipeline using old key.
ben: Stop the TS rollout, do not flip any routes. Revert pinning for external customers; keep internal pins but mark as holdback.
maria: Agreed. Rollback TS pin change and open a postmortem ticket. We'll continue with py final publish if py is stable.
sam: Reverted TS pins. Internal tests still pinned but flagged.
frank: py final publish checklist: 1) bump docs, 2) tag release, 3) upload wheels and sdists, 4) update release notes PR, 5) signal marketing. Ready to go?
leo: Suggest enabling the safety hold flag on the publish bot in case any downstream checksum pops.
maria: Good call. frank, can you toggle publish-bot hold = true during the TS investigation, allow py-only flows?
frank: Done — publish-bot hold=true for TS packages. py flows unaffected.
ben: Also add a line in the deprecation blurb: 'legacy sync client will be removed in next major; use async client or helper wrappers.' Keep it short.
maria: I'll update the changelog PR now and merge when CI passes.
deploy-bot: py-sdk@1.12.0 released to public registry, tags pushed.
sam: Merged changelog PR and published migration link. :shipit:
leo: Filing infra ticket to rotate npm signing key and run a dry-run publish to staging tomorrow.
maria: Thanks everyone. Postmortem and followups: rotate key, add signer verification step to preflight, and include a rollback button in console for npm artifacts. I'll create the ticket and assign. :thumbsup:
